guarantees.claim: out_req_o is asserted high when en_i is high and count_q equals 3'd4; otherwise it is low.
we[i] (for i from 0 to 3) is asserted high when en_i is high and count_q equals i; otherwise we[i] is low.
in_prd is assigned from prd_i bits: prd_1 <= prd_i[7:0], prd_2 <= prd_i[11:8], prd_3 <= prd_i[19:12], prd_4 <= prd_i[27:20].
prd_o is a concatenation of out_prd.prd_3, out_prd.prd_2, and out_prd.prd_1 (msb to lsb); prd_4 is not included.

assumptions.claim: count_q never exceeds 3'd4 during normal operation; otherwise out_req_o and we are never asserted.
assumptions.cond: when en_i is high and the S-Box pipeline is active
assumptions.risk: Pipeline stall: out_req_o is permanently low, no output request generated, and no new data is written, causing deadlock.

assumptions.claim: prd_i is driven by a fresh, independent random source with sufficient entropy per cycle; its bits are not predictable or constant.
assumptions.cond: during every cycle when en_i is high
assumptions.risk: If prd_i is predictable or repeats, the masking scheme breaks and side-channel leakage is possible.

assumptions.claim: The out_prd structure has fields prd_3, prd_2, prd_1 with matching bit widths to form prd_o as intended; the omission of prd_4 is an external topological decision.
assumptions.cond: whenever prd_o is consumed by downstream logic
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch leads to elaboration/synthesis errors; an unintended missing prd_4 may break mask propagation in the chain.

assumptions.claim: en_i is asserted only when valid input data is present and remains high for a complete 5‑cycle window (count_q 0‑4).
assumptions.risk: Premature deassertion of en_i can cause incomplete writes (we missing) or failure to assert out_req_o, breaking the handshake and stalling.

uncertain_points.claim: prd_o intentionally omits out_prd.prd_4; it is unclear whether this is correct for the mask chain and whether the missing randomness leads to unmasked intermediate values.
uncertain_points.cond: always, when prd_o is used by the next stage
uncertain_points.risk: If the next stage expects prd_4, masking is incomplete and side‑channel leakage could occur.

uncertain_points.claim: count_q generation in the parent FSM may produce values >4; currently no local protection and out_req_o/we would never assert, causing deadlock.
uncertain_points.cond: when the external FSM transitions to an illegal count_q
uncertain_points.risk: Permanent pipeline stall; no error detection, no watchdog, no recovery.

uncertain_points.claim: The extraction of prd_i[27:20] assumes prd_i is at least 28 bits wide; if the port width is narrower, the reference is out of bounds.
uncertain_points.cond: at compile/elaboration time if the actual width of prd_i is less than 28
uncertain_points.risk: Synthesis/simulation error or undefined behavior due to out-of-range bit select.
